studies.title: Higher-dimensional market inputs
studies.question: Does a richer market representation improve portfolio decisions?
studies.design: Initial fixed split; preliminary, not nested walk-forward.

studies.title: Annual RL walk-forward
studies.question: Does annual retraining generalize across later market years?
studies.design: Nested prior-year selection, expanding versus rolling history, three seeds, continuous holdings.

studies.title: Daily, weekly, monthly or annual learning
studies.question: How much does the frequency of policy updates matter?
studies.design: Same daily trading opportunities; fixed small budget per update; two seeds.

studies.title: Additional seeds and no-retraining control
studies.question: Was a strong-looking result just a fortunate training run?
studies.design: Three additional seeds; frozen, monthly and daily policies.

studies.title: Retraining timing with comparable computation
studies.question: Does fresher data help, or did daily retraining simply do more work?
studies.design: Training budget accrues per elapsed session and is spent at each update.

studies.title: Momentum, reversal and volatility control
studies.question: Do stronger conventional ideas survive different trading frequencies and costs?
studies.design: Prior-year selection among signal settings, decision intervals and trade bands.

studies.title: Networks, crowding and adaptive rules
studies.question: Can ideas from networks and feedback control improve allocation?
studies.design: Six explicit hypotheses; prior-year settings; higher-cost stress tests.

studies.title: Try to disprove the peer-shock explanation
studies.question: Does the peer network add more than reversal, random connections or a few stocks?
studies.design: Original schedule frozen; random peers, reversal-only, leave-one-out and cost controls.

studies.title: Five-minute peer transmission
studies.question: Do correlated peers help forecast the next few minutes after market effects?
studies.design: Monthly nested ridge forecasts; one-minute latency; within-session labels; not a portfolio simulation.

studies.title: Simple portfolios at controlled risk
studies.question: How do RL runs compare with simple risk-targeted references?
studies.design: Predeclared targets, lagged risk estimates, no leverage and trading costs.

studies.title: Interest on idle cash
studies.question: Do defensive strategies look different when cash earns interest?
studies.design: Frozen strategy settings and explicit rate proxies; not historical broker statements.

studies.title: Does unusual news attention add to price signals?
studies.question: Does company news intensity improve momentum or reversal after conservative delays?
studies.design: Prior-year selection, price-only controls including identical schedules, costs and extra news delay; retrospective archive.

studies.title: Falsification of the stronger stock-reversal result
studies.question: Does reversal survive different stocks, costs, delays and random ranking?
studies.design: Frozen schedule, exact baseline reproduction, leave-one-out, random losing-stock baskets, cost/delay controls and exploratory paired intervals.

studies.title: A pre-test-period financial-language model
studies.question: Does fixed-model headline sentiment improve allocation beyond price controls?
studies.design: December 2020 classifier; bounded single-stock headlines; prior-year selection, costs and extra delay; current archive caveat.

studies.title: Does sentiment survive attempts to disprove it?
studies.question: Does sentiment add more than favorable issuers, coverage or arbitrary ranking?
studies.design: Frozen schedule; exact reproduction, issuer permutations, random positive/covered names, exclusions, costs and matched-risk stock reference.

studies.title: Frozen sentiment strategy on new issuers
studies.question: Does the sentiment rule transfer to 24 additional stocks without retuning?
studies.design: Original settings frozen; 24 new and 40 combined stocks; corrected actions, costs, extra delay, permutations and same-risk references.

studies.title: VOO and SPY passive references
studies.question: How do paid whole-share reinvestment and cash dividends compare?
studies.design: Audited raw ETF histories and corporate actions; actual whole-share purchase costs; embedded fund expenses; no sales.

studies.title: Frozen strategy under IRA account constraints
studies.question: How much do wash prevention, settlement and capital size change the same strategy?
studies.design: Exact legacy reproduction; unchanged discovery settings; isolated account changes and higher-cost scenario.

studies.title: Broader IRA strategy and equal-stock controls
studies.question: Does the IRA strategy outperform simple controls beyond the discovery stocks?
studies.design: Frozen 24-new/40-combined stock signals; 180000 starting capital; conservative cash versus proceeds reinvestment; higher costs.

studies.title: Fixed ETF allocation rules in an IRA
studies.question: Do simple fixed ETF rules offer a useful alternative to stock sentiment?
studies.design: Five unoptimized rules, 21-session decisions, 2 percent trade bands, two settlement modes and matching passive benchmarks.

studies.title: Interest on settled IRA cash
studies.question: Do defensive ETF results change when idle cash earns modeled interest?
studies.design: Same frozen rules; full-rate and threshold/spread proxies from delayed federal-funds history. Settled cash only; no historical broker-rate claim.

studies.title: Daily execution of frozen IRA allocations
studies.question: Does daily execution reduce missed allocations after settlement without updating the signal?
studies.design: Combined 40 stocks; unchanged decision dates and weights between decisions; daily share targets, zero/2 percent trade bands, equal-stock and cost controls.

studies.title: Yearly consistency and uncertainty of the IRA candidate
studies.question: Is the apparent advantage consistent through time and distinguishable from uncertainty?
studies.design: Unmodified curves; yearly returns and paired circular blocks of 5/20/60 sessions. Exploratory post-selection intervals, not confirmatory inference.

studies.title: Can shuffled sentiment explain the IRA result?
studies.question: Does issuer-specific sentiment add more than the execution rule and price reversal?
studies.design: Exact candidate reproduction, three fixed issuer permutations and price-only reversal. Same signal dates, daily execution and 2 percent band; no retuning.

studies.title: Low-turnover taxable portfolios with modest margin
studies.question: How do borrowing costs and trading burden change fixed ETF strategies?
studies.design: 18 fixed rule/cadence/leverage scenarios plus VOO and SPY paid-cash reinvestment controls; daily risk checks and financing; no retuning.

studies.title: Borrowing and trading cost stress for taxable controls
studies.question: Do fixed low-turnover results survive higher borrowing and execution costs?
studies.design: Exact repeats plus two fixed cost stresses for all quarterly volatility multipliers and higher-cost VOO/SPY controls.

studies.title: Frozen taxable controls through 2020–2021
studies.question: How do the unchanged low-turnover controls behave through the COVID-era shock?
studies.design: Backward time transfer of three fixed quarterly volatility multipliers plus audited VOO/SPY benchmarks; no retuning.
